# FnDepot - FNOS Decentralized App Sub-Repository

## Overview

FnDepot is a decentralized third-party app manager that runs on FNOS (FeiNiu OS). It lets users discover, install, and manage third-party apps through multiple community-maintained app sources (Repositories), avoiding the limitations of a single centralized app store.

This document defines the build specification, directory structure, and metadata standards for FnDepot app sources. Developers must strictly follow this specification so that FnDepot clients can correctly parse, index, and distribute the app source.

## App List

| App | Description | Version |
|------|------|------|
| [OpenList](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/OpenList/) | Resilient, long-term governed, community-driven fork of AList, a file listing program supporting multiple storage backends | 4.2.2-10 |
| [AdGuardHome](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/AdGuardHome/) | Free, open-source, powerful network-wide ad and tracker blocking DNS server | 0.107.77-15 |
| [TaoSync](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/TaoSync/) | Automated sync tool for OpenList/AList v3+ | 0.3.2-9 |
| [SmartDNS](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/smartdns/) | Open-source DNS server for accelerating and optimizing network access | 48.2-006 |
| [DBland](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/DBland/) | Web-based database connection tool implemented in Go, supporting MySQL, Oracle, and SQLite | 1.1.1-003 |
| [EasyTier-EUI](https://github.com/710850609/FnDepot/blob/HEAD/EasyTier-EUI/) | A simplified UI for EasyTier for quickly building networks | 1.2.020604-20260626165647 |

## fnpack.json Metadata Specification

`fnpack.json` is FnDepot's core configuration file. For the detailed specification, see:

# Honghu Yixue

> Automatic learning and assignment assistance with built-in AI answering for mainstream online courses including Chaoxing Xuexitong, Zhihuishu, Zhijiaoyun, Yuketang, and U-Campus

## Introduction

Honghu Yixue offers two ways to use it: a browser extension and a desktop application, helping university students complete online courses and assignments efficiently. It supports mainstream online course platforms including Chaoxing Xuexitong, Zhihuishu, Zhijiaoyun, Yuketang, China University MOOC, and U-Campus, with built-in AI answering capability.

## Features

- Supports online course platforms including Chaoxing Xuexitong, Zhihuishu, Zhijiaoyun, Yuketang, China University MOOC, and U-Campus
- Automatic learning and assignment assistance
- Built-in AI answering (supports large models such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic)
- Question bank configuration and online question search
- Question bank caching

## Browser Extension Installation

### Option 1: Store Installation

- Edge Add-ons Store: [鸿鹄易学 - Microsoft Edge 加载项](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/ocidllankdjkcieeefhgmgnkppcbdfhh)

### Option 2: Manual Installation

1. Find the latest version in the Release page and download `extension.zip`
2. Unzip the zip file
3. Open the browser extension management page (Chrome: `chrome://extensions`, Edge: `edge://extensions`)
4. Enable "Developer mode"
5. Click "Load unpacked" and select the unzipped `extension` directory

## Desktop Application

The Honghu Yixue desktop application is a browser automation tool for online course scenarios, suited to users who need to run multiple browser instances, automatic login, and centralized task management.

- **Multiple browser instances**: Each browser instance uses an independent cache and login environment, without interference
- **Built-in extension**: The Honghu Yixue extension is automatically loaded when a browser starts, with no manual installation needed
- **Automatic login**: Supports Zhihuishu school login and mobile phone password login, with slider captcha recognition
- **Automation programs**: Configure automatic learning, assignments, and other tasks centrally in the desktop application
- **Centralized management**: Uniformly manage browser configurations, caches, bookmarks, and task records

> Desktop installers are published along with the Release. Download and run the installer to use it; you can choose the installation directory during setup. The Windows installer filename is `鸿鹄易学-<版本>-setup-win-x64.exe`.

- [GitCode Releases](https://gitcode.com/honghutech/honghueasystudy/releases)
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/HONGHUTECHNOLOGY/honghueasystudy/releases)

## Development

```bash
npm install        # Install dependencies
npm run build:ext  # Build the browser extension
```…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

TIANLI0/EncoDeck.body: > 🍎 **Mac users** are recommended to use [HeyBuds](https://github.com/abaichuan1017/HeyBuds). EncoDeck is a Windows earbuds control tool written in **WinUI 3**. It brings common earbud settings to the PC: check left and right earbud and charging case battery levels, switch noise control, adjust EQ and spatial audio, and manage earbud touch controls. You can keep just a tray icon running without leaving the main window open all the time. It currently focuses on **OPPO / OnePlus** earbuds and also supports some **realme / DIZO, vivo / iQOO, Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi / Redmi, Sony, AKG, Sennheiser, Edifier, MOONDROP, Samsung, Google, Bose, Nothing / CMF** earbuds and USB 2.4G gaming headsets. Available settings vary by model. **Hardware verification is currently done mainly on the OPPO Enco X4**; other models are implemented mainly based on protocols and model configuration. Test feedback is welcome. ## Interface | Main interface | Tray quick panel | | :---: | :---: | | | | ## Features ### Battery and connection status After connecting earbuds, the main window and tray panel show the battery levels reported by the device. True wireless earbuds show the left earbud, right earbud, and charging case as supported; headphones show a single battery level. Charging status, wearing status, in-case status, and firmware version depend on the model. The charging case usually stops reporting battery levels after the earbuds are removed, so EncoDeck keeps the most recent reading and labels it "last read" rather than presenting old data as real-time battery. It also alerts you when the battery is low. ### Noise control Switch modes from the tray without opening the main window: - **Noise cancelling / Transparency / Off / Adaptive** (depending on the earbud model); - Noise cancelling strength: **Deep, Medium, Light, Smart switching**; - Noise cancelling preference in adaptive mode (when supported by the earbuds). If noise control is changed with earbud gestures or the phone, EncoDeck also reads the status reported by the earbuds and updates the interface. Control commands are sent over Bluetooth, and EncoDeck waits for the earbuds to confirm and read back the change. If a command fails, the button does not stay stuck in an error state. You can also bind global hotkeys under "Settings → Shortcuts", such as one key to switch between noise cancelling and transparency, or to jump directly to a specific mode. These work during fullscreen games as well. ### Sound Sound options are displayed based on the earbud model configuration and actual capabilities. | Setting | What it can do | | --- | --- | | **EQ** | Switch the earbuds' built-in sound presets, such as Dynaudio-related presets, vocal, treble, and bass (names vary by model) | | **Custom EQ** | Edit, save, switch, and delete EQ on supported OPPO models; Enco X4 supports up to 3 sets with 10 bands each |…

# Armbian Actions

Build official **Armbian** firmware and kernels via **GitHub Actions**

---

## 📦 Kernel Configuration
- Enables **eBPF** by default, compatible with **DAE proxy**
- Supported platforms: `meson64` `sunxi64` `rockchip64` `rk35xx`

---

## 🖥️ Supported Devices
- See the official **Armbian** [device list](https://github.com/armbian/build/tree/main/config/boards)

---

## ⚙️ Device Optimizations

### Nanopc-T4
- **CPU frequency**
  - Little cores: 1.5GHz
  - Big cores: 2.0GHz
- **Extended support**
  - PCIe 2.1 x4 enabled
- **Fan policy**
  - ≥ 45°C → fan starts
  - ≥ 65°C → fan at full speed

---

### Rock5C Lite
- **System optimizations**
  - Removes **U-Boot** detection of the **GPU**, enables the **GPU** node
  - Network interface: `end*` → `eth0`
- **Fan policy (BSP kernel)**
  - ≥ 45°C → 40%
  - ≥ 55°C → 55%
  - ≥ 65°C → 75%
  - ≥ 70°C → 88%
  - ≥ 75°C → 100%
- **Network support**
  - **WiFi** is not supported by default; install the [aic8800 driver](https://github.com/radxa-pkg/aic8800) yourself

---

### Panther-X2
- **CPU frequency**: 2.0GHz
- **Multimedia support**: **vendor** firmware supports **Jellyfin** hardware transcoding
- **Network interface**: `end*` → `eth0`

---

## 🔧 Other Changes
- Removes the kernel version suffix
- Fills in the **model name** field in **cpuinfo**
- **Aml-s9xx-box** firmware defaults to the **Phicomm N1 box** (just extract and write to a USB drive); the script for writing to **EMMC** is in the /root directory
- New command tools:
  - `armbian-apt` `armbian-update` `armbian-update-os` `armbian-sync`

## ⚠️ Notice

**Please read the following before using this API.**

- **This is unofficial.** It has no relationship with the BOATRACE official website or related organizations.
- **This is not real-time.** Data is updated periodically about every 10 minutes via GitHub Actions, so there may be a delay of roughly 10–20 minutes before the latest information is reflected.
- **Accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed.** Due to collection and conversion constraints, missing or incorrect data may be included.
- **If you need official information, always check the BOATRACE official website.**
- **Use at your own risk.**

---

## 📝 Overview

This API provides boat race (kyotei) data. The data is published on GitHub Pages and provided in JSON format.

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Supported venues | All 24 venues nationwide (a single day's data includes information for all venues) |
| Available data | Racecards, just-before information, results |

---

## 🌐 Endpoint

Supported period: **From 2026-01-01 onward**

```bash
https://boatraceopenapi.github.io/api/v1/YYYY/YYYYMMDD.json
```

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year, month, and day
- Dates are based on Japan Standard Time (JST / UTC+9)

> If a date with no data is specified (outside the supported period, future dates, etc.), GitHub Pages returns HTTP 404 as per its specification.

---

For the JSON structure of the response and details of each field, see the schema documentation.

→ [docs/v1/schema.md](https://github.com/boatraceopenapi/api/blob/HEAD/docs/v1/schema.md)

A Telegram bot that voices text using the ELAN TTS Russian (Nicolai 16Khz) voice via `balcon.exe` under Wine. The whole point is this voice, so the engine and Wine version are pinned in the image. This is an x86 image; on ARM it runs through QEMU.

mason173/aira-browser.body:
Aira is an open-source HarmonyOS NEXT browser, with source code released under GPL-3.0. The same repository also includes a desktop sync extension and a single-owner service for self-hosted sync.

Browsing, bookmarks, history, downloads, filtering, scripts, and the home page can all be handled locally. Community does not depend on Aira's official cloud or a Huawei account; to sync across devices, use your own WebDAV or Personal Server.

## Interface

Real interface screenshots:

## Features

### Browsing

- Native HarmonyOS NEXT client, supporting phones, tablets, and 2in1 devices.
- Multiple tabs, startup restore, background tab resource management, and automatic closing of tabs based on how long they have gone unused.
- Drag-to-reorder bottom toolbar; appearance, theme, app icon, and top immersive mode are adjustable.
- Custom home page, where you can write your own page; websites can also be installed as desktop apps.
- Large screens have keyboard shortcuts and two-column settings.

### Privacy and Security

- Private mode is stored separately from regular browsing data, can require identity verification on entry, and can blur private tab previews.
- Ad and web content filtering, with support for custom rules and manual element hiding.
- Anti-tracking, cookie policies, site permissions, external app redirect control, and secure DNS.
- Local password vault with autofill.
- Local backup import and export. Community does not connect to the official cloud by default, and does not send browsing data to Aira servers.

### Web Features

- User scripts.
- Web page translation, with configurable translation services.
- Download management: save location, segmented downloads, failure recovery, private downloads.
- Reader mode and offline pages.
- Novel mode and novel bookshelf.
- Web video takeover.

memoryttt/shadowrocket-adblock.description: Aggregated ad blocking: Qiufeng + fmz200 automatically merged daily into a single Shadowrocket module
memoryttt/shadowrocket-adblock.body:
# shadowrocket-adblock

Merges multiple ad-blocking modules (Qiufeng AWAvenue + fmz200 per-App modules) into a **single** Shadowrocket module every day, automatically, with security checks before each merge.

## Usage

Shadowrocket → Settings → Modules → Add remote module:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/memoryttt/shadowrocket-adblock/main/dist/merged.sgmodule
```

The module includes its own `[MITM]` section (hostnames already merged). Enable MITM, then install and trust the certificate. You don't need to enter decryption domains manually.

## Coverage

Splash and popup ad blocking for QQ Music, Amap (Gaode Maps), Taobao, JD.com, China Unicom, Meituan, Bilibili, Didi Chuxing, and Xianyu,
plus blocking of third-party ad domains across all Apps from Qiufeng AWAvenue.

## Automatic Updates

`.github/workflows/merge.yml` runs daily at 19:17 UTC (Beijing 03:17). It pulls upstream, runs security checks, merges, and commits.
You can also trigger it manually with `Run workflow` on the Actions page. After you edit `sources.txt`, it re-merges automatically.

## Security Checks (merge.py)

Checks run before every merge. If any one matches, **updates stop** (the previous version is kept, so poisoned content is not published) and an alert is raised:

1. **Dangerous MITM wildcards**: full-TLD decryption such as `*` or `*.com` (domain-restricted entries such as `*.amap.com` are allowed).
2. **MITM sensitive domains**: domains of banking, payment, and account systems.
3. **Script source allowlist**: `script-path` pointing to a domain outside the allowlist.
4. **Script exfiltration signatures**: scans remotely fetched scripts for outbound-transfer or obfuscation signatures.
5. **Baseline comparison**: `baseline.json` records content hashes for upstream and scripts, and changes are included in the report.

Exit codes: `0` passed; `1` runtime error; `2` security risk (updates stopped).

## Adding or Removing Apps

Edit `sources.txt` (one module URL per line) and push. Adding a script from a non-GitHub source triggers an update stop. If the source is trusted, explicitly add its host to `ALLOWED_SCRIPT_HOSTS` in `merge.py`.
fmz200 module directory: <https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/tree/main/Surge/module/split>

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.

- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.

oxmumu3/dsh-family-assistant.body:
# Lele Family Assistant · AI Avatar Family Edition

📖 Design reflections and ecosystem review: [“Will DeepSeek Harness Head Toward a Geek Toy or Universal Access?”](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/RIAYNqo8OsUVx2JpR8MPyA)

A DeepSeek Harness Host that serves several elders at once. Each elder chats in WeChat, sets reminders, and receives a personalized daily digest. The Owner manages everything in a workspace and receives the daily service briefing in their own WeChat.

Target hosts: **0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1**. The fixed distribution entry is the [npm public package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@oxmumu3/dsh-family-assistant) `@oxmumu3/dsh-family-assistant@latest`. Each time a new version is published to npm, `latest` is updated, and the package name used when sharing does not change. This is a community plugin and is not listed in the official Harness plugin marketplace.

## What it can do now

- If a daily-report or weather-tool subscription misses its scheduled time, it fires again within two hours. Each schedule is deduplicated by its original date and time. Runs that already executed, or whose outcome is unknown, are not repeated. Creating or changing a subscription does not send content from before authorization.

- Proactive alerts for important matters: once enabled, Lele assists in judging newly received text messages from family members and recent context from the Owner. When something needs the Owner's attention, it sends a proactive reminder quoting the minimum necessary words. Updates about the same matter are merged. Ordinary chat, forwarded news, and routine matters already handled do not trigger individual notifications. The Owner can continue directly in WeChat by saying “I'll handle it”, “resolved”, or “tell her: …”. The judgment is not guaranteed to cover every case. Only text this service has received is processed; other WeChat chats are not monitored.
- The Owner's main conversation and ordinary WeChat requests connect directly to a real native Harness session. It discovers registered projects on its own and uses the host's file and search tools. Each turn does not require first naming a project. Follow-up messages stay in the native session, and each turn is accounted for separately. Each family member uses an independent personal Agent, and additional projects and dedicated services are opened only with that person's authorization. The control session uses the host's tools and approvals. Native approvals and interactive questions are still handled in the corresponding Host session.
- Existing AI daily reports can automatically find the day's finished output in registered projects based on metadata, with already-organized WeChat versions given priority. Follow-ups such as “go find it yourself” or “send one now” keep the same target and materials. A trial send has persistent deduplication and segmented state. No daily subscription is opened. If it fails or the outcome is unknown, it is not resent automatically. A daily schedule can explicitly select the latest generated output from the same source, with the source date and the receipt time each handled in their own time zone. If today's output is missing, an old file is not sent. Legacy fixed-file schedules keep their original scope.

- The Owner can say in the console or in their own WeChat, “Send the AI daily report to Mom every morning at eight,” and Lele will search registered projects for candidate materials, reuse the family member's existing time zone, and ask only about missing items. Verification, source selection, revisions, and confirmation and saving all happen in the same conversation. Weather and PPT also use the same configuration entry. Confirmation does not mean the task has been executed or delivered. Scheduling currently supports daily only.

slovx2/litch.description: One interface for all your coding agents: an open-source desktop client that brings Claude Code, Pi, Codex and other harnesses into one window.
slovx2/litch.body:
# Litch

**Simplified Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/slovx2/litch/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

Litch is dedicated to delivering a comfortable desktop client and remote connection experience.

- Direct SSH connection
- Mobile (Android) direct SSH connection to remote devices, usable even when the desktop app is not running
- Built-in browser + Computer Use (macOS, Windows)
- When connected to the desktop, remote devices can use the desktop browser and Computer Use features, and, with your approval, can also run commands and read/write files on this computer
- Session tree (spawn sub-sessions across harnesses, report back, and wake up) and scheduled tasks (run on the device on schedule, even when the desktop app is closed)
- Scan a QR code to bind a remote device already configured on the desktop to your phone, without setting up SSH keys on the phone

## Interface

### Retro Geek (default)

### Literary Humanities

Screenshots show demo data. Themes, light/dark mode, and language (Chinese / English) can be switched at any time.

## Features

- **Remote connection.** Connects through your own ssh config and keys, with no ports opened on either side; reconnects automatically after a disconnect, without losing turns.
- **Multiple harnesses.** Claude Code, Pi, Codex, plus the experimental DeepSeek Harness (DSH), OpenCode, and ACP agents (Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, etc.), all in one window.
- **Built-in browser.** Shared by you and the agent; the remote localhost is automatically forwarded over ssh.
- **Computer Use (macOS, Windows).** The agent operates any application on this computer without per-app approval; a notice appears on screen while it acts, and pressing Esc stops it.
- **Operate this computer.** With your approval, agents on remote devices can run commands, read and write files, and copy files between the two machines on this desktop computer; off by default, enabled per device.
- **Session tree.** Sessions can spawn sub-sessions, including across harnesses: a Claude Code session can spawn sub-sessions for Codex, Pi, etc., and vice versa. Sub-sessions nest under their parent session, report back to it when they finish, and wake it up to continue work if needed.
- **Scheduled tasks.** Tasks are stored and run on the device on schedule, continuing even when the desktop app is closed or disconnected; each run either starts a new session or sends into an existing one.
- **Pair a phone by scanning a QR code.** The desktop app (or `litch pair` on that machine) displays a QR code. After the phone scans it, it generates its own key and registers with that machine; you verify the confirmation code on your computer and click Allow. The computer's key never leaves the computer, and each phone can be revoked individually.
- **Coding panels.** Terminal (persists across disconnects), file tree, and diff review.
- **Mobile (Android).** Connects directly to remote devices over SSH, without going through the desktop app and with no relay service: view sessions, send messages, approve actions, open terminals, and manage scheduled tasks; scan a code to bind a device already configured on the desktop.

sokcuri/hdTrans.body:
# Hardtrans (hdTrans)

An offline translator that translates Japanese into Korean. It runs on your own computer without an internet connection, and can be used directly with games and translation tools that used EZTrans.

Creator: Sokcuri ([Homepage](https://sokcuri.neko.kr/), [X](https://x.com/sokcuri))

Before installing, you can try it right away in the [web translator](https://trans.kuri.kr).

| Japanese | EZTrans | hdTrans |
|---|---|---|
| 肉がジュージューと焼ける | The meat Jews Jews burns | The meat sizzles as it cooks |
| バイトに行く | Goes to baito | Goes to a part-time job |
| おっと、すまんね | Husband, sorry | Whoops, sorry |
| 夢みたい | Want to see a dream | It's like a dream |
| くそっ！ | Poop! | Damn! |
| やったー！ | Did it-! | Yes! |

EZTrans results were taken from the [public comparison post](https://x.com/sokcuri/status/2111443062698451143/photo/1), and hdTrans results were translated with 0.8.4.
More comparisons are in the [translation quality benchmark](https://github.com/sokcuri/hdTrans/blob/HEAD/docs/benchmarks.md).

## Features

It translates using dictionaries and grammar rules. Incorrect sentences have been found one by one and the dictionaries and rules manually fixed. Each time a fix is made, roughly 100,000 lines of novels, games, and subtitles are re-translated to check that no other sentences were broken.

- Chooses between casual and polite speech for dialogue according to context.
- If the characters and place names of a work are listed, they are read as names, and honorifics, Korean particles, and spacing are matched as well.
- It does not use machine learning. The same sentence always produces the same result, and when something is wrong, the dictionary entry or rule that caused it is found and fixed.

## Download

Get the file for your operating system from the [latest release](https://github.com/sokcuri/hdTrans/releases/latest).

supElement/ComfyUI-Element_TileEdit.body:
# ComfyUI-Element_TileEdit

A ComfyUI extension for tiled refinement / editing / upscaling designed specifically for image editing models (single image only), providing powerful tile control and local refinement capabilities.
Supported models: Qwen-Image 2.1 / Edit 2509 / 2511, FLUX.3 / FLUX.2 klein, Krea2 + identity_edit lora, Moss + Moss-Image-Edit lora.

✨ Tiled upscaling: say goodbye to the cross-tile tearing of traditional img2img.
Uses tile references to ensure cross-tile consistency. You can confidently raise the Denoise repaint strength to 0.7–1.0 while perfectly preserving the original image's character identity, structure, and texture details. Supports a custom reference strength per sampling step, precisely balancing "repair strength" and "consistency." This is something traditional img2img tiled upscaling cannot do.

✨ Tile control and local refinement: spatial tiles replace masks.
Manual split mode (by Manual) provides true "tile-level semantic isolation" and pixel-level control. For example, you can precisely box-select the layer containing the "white shirt" and enter only "change to a blue shirt" in that layer's Prompt. Unselected areas such as the background, hair, and table are automatically assigned to the Gap fill region, which does not receive this instruction (or only receives basic global quality enhancement instructions), thus remaining perfectly unchanged.
> How to use: CTRL + left-drag to add tiles.
> Independent upscaling: each manually split layer can have its own upscale size, giving core editing areas higher resolution and detail.
> ⚠️ Editing with the Krea2 model requires the [krea2_identity_edit](https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/tree/main) lora.
> ⚠️ Editing with the Moss model requires the [Moss-Image-Edit](https://huggingface.co/chinoll/Moss-Image-Edit/tree/main) lora.
---

---

---
## Why it's needed
Editing models are picky about full-image inputs:

> Image too large: most models start to degrade beyond 2K, and some beyond 1K, and may even ignore instructions;
> 
> Target too small: when the region to refine occupies too small a share of the full image, direct editing is often ineffective or gives poor results;
> 
> Too many instructions: one image cannot hold many instructions, and multiple instructions interfere with and forget each other.

After tiling: each tile returns to a resolution the model handles comfortably; small targets get their own tile and can have an individually set upscale factor; each instruction is written only into its own layer's prompt, and unselected areas automatically fall into gap-fill tiles and stay unchanged. Spatial isolation replaces instruction stacking.

> Upscaling: the deadlock of img2img
> 
> Traditional tiled upscaling (TTP, Ultimate SD Upscale, etc.) uses the img2img path, where "redraw strength" and "feature preservation" share the same denoise…
